channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Trump says U.S. will hike Canada auto tariffs to 50% as trade war escalates
item.description: President Donald Trump said the U.S. will raise tariffs on imports of cars, trucks and auto parts from Canada to 50% on Jan. 1, 2027

item.title: Bessent could tap near $1 trillion Treasury General Account to fund bond buybacks, sources said
item.description: Using the TGA would provide the Treasury with considerable firepower to influence long-term bond yields.

item.title: Goldman Sachs partner warns of 'huge danger' in letting AI replace bankers' reasoning skills
item.description: Goldman Sachs is embracing AI, but one of its senior tech leaders warns that it comes with an unintended risk: weakening the reasoning skills of future bankers.

item.title: Nvidia says Groq racks will be online this year following $20 billion purchase
item.description: Nvidia's race to manufacture Groq chips and make them available to customers highlights the growing importance in AI of low-latency inference.

item.title: California AG Rob Bonta cancels Paramount settlement meeting, citing 'lack of good faith'
item.description: California AG Rob Bonta was scheduled to meet with Paramount representatives on Monday, he said, but canceled the meeting.

item.title: Biotech stocks are breaking out. How Josh Brown is trading them
item.description: Josh Brown and Sean Russo take a look at these two biotech names after a strong week for the sector.

item.title: Crypto extends gains after biggest 3-day rally since 2023
item.description: Bitcoin and crypto stocks extended their rally after the flagship cryptocurrency broke out of its trading range.

item.title: Santoli: Why all the fuss about bond yields is happening now
item.description: The textbooks say the cycle high in real yields should act as a restraint on economic growth and equity valuations.

item.title: Trump Media CEO defends selling faster access to president's Truth Social posts, says more have signed up
item.description: Trump Media interim CEO Kevin McGurn defended his company offering faster access to President Donald Trump's Truth Social posts.

item.title: Prediction market traders doubtful Bessent’s bond interventions will push yields lower
item.description: Speculators still see yields hitting new highs in 2026 and ending the year at levels elevated from where they're currently trading.

item.title: U.S. to unveil 'greatest financial offensive' against Iran as Tehran threatens ship seizures
item.description: The escalation came as both sides have missed a 60-day ceasefire window to reach a deal, closing off the formal truce mechanism to end the six-month war.

item.title: United's next decision: What to do with all those Boeing 737 Max 10 seats it ordered years ago
item.description: United Airlines wanted to put lie-flat premium seats on its Max 10 planes once they were certified, but that has been delayed by years.

item.title: 401(k) rollovers can be costly — and irreversible. What to know before moving your money
item.description: Rollovers from 401(k)-type plans to IRAs are growing more common. But there are pros and cons.

item.title: Yields decline on CNBC report Treasury could use General Account to fund buybacks
item.description: Treasury yields fell Monday as investors await Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's keynote speech at Jackson Hole later this week.

item.title: Shares of this sandwich chain that recently went public may surge, Loop Capital says
item.description: Jersey Mike's offers a unique experience to customers, and its shares should grow as marketing initiatives are refreshed, an analyst says.

item.title: A media M&A chill: The Paramount-WBD antitrust challenge may hold up more deals than one
item.description: Paramount's proposed merger with WBD is delayed while an antitrust lawsuit plays out. The holdup could mean a freeze across the media industry.

item.title: UPS is investing $2 billion in international, healthcare and supply chain businesses
item.description: UPS told CNBC exclusively that the company is investing more than $2 billion into its international, healthcare and supply chain businesses.

item.title: Zillow settles FTC claims it paid Redfin to stop competing on apartment listings
item.description: The FTC and states were ready to argue at trial Monday that the Zillow-Redfin partnership drove up costs for landlords and decreased listing quality.

item.title: Democratic House leader Jeffries meets with Jared Kushner as midterms loom
item.description: Democrats are currently favored to win a majority in the House of Representatives after November's elections.

item.title: Wells Fargo and Citigroup have room to buy a big bank. These 5 regionals fit the bill
item.description: Citigroup and Wells Fargo have room to buy a big regional bank as regulators have opened the door to megadeals. Five regional banks make sense as targets.

item.title: We're booking a 300% profit in an AI winner and buying more of a healthcare name
item.description: The trim puts the portfolio in a better position to withstand backlash against data centers.

item.title: Accordia Bank is offering a 5.00% APY booster on high-yield savings account for its rebrand — how to get it
item.description: Utah residents can snag a 5.00% APY boost as Accordia Bank celebrates its rebrand, while everyone else can still earn a competitive rate.

item.title: Ex-Google recruiter: This common mistake makes your resume 'invisible'—you have 'six seconds to prove you can do the work'
item.description: Ex-Google recruiter Farah Sharghi says that to succeed in this job market, emphasize proof you can do the job, rather than your potential on your resume.

item.title: Alibaba plunges after announcing $10.2 billion share placement to fund AI push
item.description: Alibaba shares plunged 10% after the tech giant priced a $10.2 billion share placement to fund its growing AI investments.

item.title: France, UK step up missile support for Ukraine as European leaders meet
item.description: France and the U.K. are boosting their missile support for Ukraine following deadly Russian drone strikes.

item.title: Equal-weight S&P 500 is leading the 2026 market and its flagship trade just hit $100 billion
item.description: Money is flooding into equal-weight stock market ETFs this year. Investing experts say it's not a fad.

item.title: After 10 years at United, CEO Scott Kirby is thinking big about the future of his airline from JFK to AI
item.description: United Airlines CEO Scott Kirby talked to CNBC in a wide-ranging interview about his proposed airline megadeals, AI and the future of the carrier.

item.title: Nvidia customers reportedly warned about AI-related price hikes
item.description: The chipmaker has told some of its largest customers that the prices of servers containing its AI chips could move more than 15% higher, Bloomberg News reported.

item.title: Inside Coca-Cola’s secretive innovation labs: How the beverage giant wants to automate dirty soda and refreshers
item.description: From McDonald's to Wendy's, longtime Coke customers have been expanding their beverage offerings to boost their profit margins.

item.title: Emergency savings shortfall signals 'danger' for working households, Suze Orman says
item.description: A new survey shows even a $500 unexpected expense may throw households off track when it comes to big life goals like saving for retirement.
